preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and len(stdin.split()[1].split()) == n
preconditions.description: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 4⋅10^5), and the second line contains exactly n integers (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in stdin.split()[1].split())
preconditions.description: All integers in the input are within the range [1, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() and int(stdout.strip().split()[0]) == x and x <= n and x > 0
postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is an integer x (1 ≤ x ≤ n), representing the total number of cells in the largest beautiful rectangle.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split()[1:] and len(stdout.strip().split()[1:]) == 2 and int(stdout.strip().split()[1]) * int(stdout.strip().split()[2]) == x
postconditions.description: The second line of stdout contains two integers p and q (p ⋅ q = x), representing the dimensions of the rectangle.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split()[3:] and len(stdout.strip().split()[3:]) == p * q and all(len(line.split()) == q for line in stdout.strip().split()[3:].split('\n')[:p])
postconditions.description: The next p lines of stdout form a p × q matrix (rectangle) where each row has exactly q elements, and the total number of elements is x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(row)) == q for row in stdout.strip().split()[3:].split('\n')[:p]) and all(len(set(col)) == p for col in zip(*[line.split() for line in stdout.strip().split()[3:].split('\n')[:p]]))
postconditions.description: The rectangle is beautiful: all elements in each row and each column are distinct.
All elements in the rectangle are chosen from the input integers.
